doc.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022

title: Woody Herman's band: personnel and recommending Tony Leonardi
summary: One-nighters by bus with Nistico, Farrell, Foster and Chase; he got Leonardi on bass.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: He got very popular. So Vegas, you know. But yeah like when I was with Woody’s band it was different traveling because we did one nighters. That was rough traveling.
Yeah on a bus, mostly on a bus. Yeah.
Was Sal Nistico in that band with you?
No it wasn’t Joe, Joe Farrell was there a while, and then Frank Foster was on the band too. And Bill Chase of course. Great trumpet player. Great players man. Tony Leonardi. I got him on the gig.
I did. I recommended him. The bass player was leaving and I said, “Get this guy from Syracuse, Tony Leonardi.” Nat Pierce was kind of in charge of the band you know.
